asserted_queries.label: Concept definition exactly one
asserted_queries.query:
PREFIX c: <http://www.loa-cnr.it/ontologies/cDnS.owl#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
ASK { c:Concept rdfs:subClassOf ?r . ?r owl:onProperty c:isDefinedIn ; owl:cardinality ?n . FILTER(?n=1) }

asserted_queries.label: General schematic conceptualization range
asserted_queries.query:

asserted_queries.label: General schematic expression without property-chain derivation
asserted_queries.query:
PREFIX c: <http://www.loa-cnr.it/ontologies/cDnS.owl#>

asserted_queries.label: Configuration has only named Collection superclass
asserted_queries.query:
PREFIX c: <http://www.loa-cnr.it/ontologies/cDnS.owl#>

ASK { c:Configuration rdfs:subClassOf c:Collection . FILTER NOT EXISTS { c:Configuration owl:equivalentClass ?x } FILTER NOT EXISTS { c:Configuration rdfs:subClassOf ?x . FILTER(?x != c:Collection) } }

asserted_queries.label: Minimum cardinality two on transitive proper-part
asserted_queries.query:
PREFIX c: <http://www.loa-cnr.it/ontologies/cDnS.owl#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
ASK { c:hasProperPart rdf:type owl:TransitiveProperty . c:Bundle rdfs:subClassOf ?r . ?r owl:onProperty c:hasProperPart ; owl:minCardinality ?n . FILTER(?n=2) }
